suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went out clean on the first try, no rollback, no 2am Slack pings.
I'm thankful for the smell of rain hitting hot tarmac right as I step out for lunch.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of rent going out on time this month without touching savings.
I'm thankful for a stack trace that actually pointed at the real problem instead of three layers of abstraction away.
I'm grateful for my grandmother's voice on the phone asking if I've eaten, every single call.
I'm thankful for the mosque car park having space on a Friday when I thought I'd be late for Jumaat.
I'm grateful for a colleague who covered my on-call shift without me having to explain why.
I'm thankful for the five minutes after Isyak when the house finally goes quiet.
I'm grateful for a teh tarik that's actually pulled properly, not just sweet milk tea with a fancy name.
I'm thankful for a merge conflict that resolved itself cleanly instead of eating my whole afternoon.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a bonus that let me finally fix my car's aircon.
I'm thankful for my mother still packing extra rice for me to bring home even though I live alone now.
I'm grateful for a bug report that came with clear steps to reproduce, for once.
I'm thankful for the quiet of the office at 7am before anyone else logs on.
I'm grateful for the highway actually moving on the drive home today.
